summary.item: Repo scaffold aligned to spec: prompts, Apps Script stub, MCP config, README prompt directory (`prompts/`, `gas/Code.gs:1`, `mcp/servers.json:1`, `README.md:1`).

Live workflow snapshot (`n8n/room-parent-updater.json:1`) captured; workflow renamed to "Room Parent Agent (WIP)" and kept editor-compatible (60-minute trigger until interval-friendly cron replacement is designed).
Prompt library expanded with WhatsApp + daily/weekly digests for tone control (`prompts/formatter_whatsapp.txt:1`, `prompts/digest_daily.txt:1`, `prompts/digest_weekly.txt:1`).
Approvals HMAC secret stored in workflow static data via helper script (`scripts/set_approvals_secret.sh:1`, node `Store Approvals Secret`).
Security scrub complete: replaced real tokens with placeholders (`mcp/servers.json:1`, `servers.json:1`, `Sequioa parent app API keys.md:1`) and added project `.gitignore:1`.

workflowState.lastSnapshot: Pulled via REST after secret storage + sanitation.

observations.item: Prototype chain intact (Gmail/Drive ingestion nodes, Gemini extraction, JSON validation, legacy approval tokens). HMAC secret available but not yet enforced.
MCP helper tools still return empty payloads; rely on REST API for workflow operations.

securityAudit.step: Replaced real credentials with `${PLACEHOLDER}` strings in `mcp/servers.json:1`, `servers.json:1`, `Sequioa parent app API keys.md:1`.
Added `.gitignore:1` to exclude node_modules, OS cruft, and local secret artifacts.
Scanned repository for known token substrings (`rg "AIza|GOCSPX|Bearer ARwy"`).
Before push, re-run `./scripts/set_approvals_secret.sh` locally post-clone; do not commit outputs or workflow backups containing secrets.

pendingWork.item: Reintroduce 2-hour (08–20 PT) schedule + daily/weekly digests using interval-friendly design compatible with n8n v1.110.1.
Unify Gmail + Drive ingestion into Gemini extractor (PDF text fallback, lookback cursors) and route into diff pipeline.

Implement diff/queue logic for Calendar + Snack sheet (Admin tab columns `WhenFound | Type | Summary | SourceLink | ApproveLink | RejectLink | Status`; OpsLog headers `Timestamp | Action | Target | DiffJSON | Actor | SourceLink`).
Replace token approval flow with HMAC validation leveraging `store.approvalsHmacSecret`.
Finalize approval UX: Sheets queue population, 24h HMAC email links, wait/resume gating.
Writebacks: safe snack/calendar upserts with de-dupe + OpsLog logging; WhatsApp draft generation via `prompts/formatter_whatsapp.txt` post-approval.
Add daily/weekly digest branches once scheduling finalized, using new prompt templates.
Investigate MCP tool responses (optional) and perform end-to-end dry run with approvals + rollback validation.

concerns.item: Ingestion/diff pipeline still incomplete; approvals currently unauthenticated tokens.
Need backward-compatible scheduling approach before enabling production cadence.

nextRecommendedSteps.item: Design 2-hour + digest scheduling using interval trigger + conditional gating for v1.110.1.
Implement ingestion → diff → approval refactor, wiring HMAC validation.
Keep `.gitignore` and sanitized placeholders intact prior to Git push.
